verdict.rationale: n8n is a workflow automation tool with event-trigger nodes: Webhook, Kafka trigger, MCP Server Trigger, and error workflows that fire on execution failure. Hands-on users confirm webhook-initiated tasks and criteria-based automated actions. missing for 10: first-party detail on conditional rule/branching logic, and in-depth trigger documentation beyond node titles.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: n8n is a fair-code licensed workflow automation tool that combines AI features with business process automation.
